title.en: Save stays visible on the agent settings page
title.zh: 智能体配置页的保存按钮不再被遮挡

description.en: Back and Save changes now sit beside the agent's name at the top of the page, clear of notifications and install progress. Notifications also use a solid background.
description.zh: 「返回」和「保存更改」移至页面顶部智能体名称右侧，不再被通知或安装进度遮挡；通知也改为不透明底色。

title.en: Self-installed agents are recognized on Windows accounts with non-English names
title.zh: 修复 Windows 中文用户名下无法识别自行安装的智能体

description.en: OpenClaw, Goose and other agents you installed yourself now run normally when the Windows user name contains Chinese or other non-English characters.
description.zh: Windows 用户名包含中文等非英文字符时，自行安装的 OpenClaw、Goose 等智能体现可正常识别并运行。

title.zh: 修复已登录的 Cursor 仍提示需要登录

description.en: After signing in with cursor-agent login, Cursor is shown as ready without an API key.
description.zh: 通过 cursor-agent login 登录后，无需填写 API 密钥即显示为就绪。

title.en: OpenClaw no longer fails to start after its credential storage upgrade
title.zh: 修复 OpenClaw 因凭据存储升级而无法启动

description.en: OpenClaw agents configured in the launcher no longer stop with "requires legacy credential migration".
description.zh: 在启动器中配置的 OpenClaw 不再因「requires legacy credential migration」而中断。
